PROJECT_01RoboticsPID Control

Robotic Manipulator
Control System

Developed a robotic manipulator control system using an ESP32 microcontroller and DC motors with encoder feedback. Implemented closed-loop PID control to achieve accurate joint positioning and smooth motion control of multiple robotic arm joints.

Firmware was structured using a class-based motor control architecture, enabling modular control of multiple motors. Encoder signals were processed using ESP32's PCNT counter-based counting to provide precise angle feedback. A custom power distribution PCB was designed to manage power delivery for motors, drivers, and control electronics.

Technologies

  • ESP32
  • DC Motors + Encoders
  • MD10C Driver
  • PID Algorithm
  • PCNT Counter
  • Embedded C/C++

Hardware Design

  • Custom power distribution PCB for motor drivers
  • Proper power routing and grounding strategy
  • Voltage regulation & filtering for stable MCU operation

Key Features

  • Multi-joint robotic arm control
  • Closed-loop motor position control via PID
  • Real-time encoder feedback processing
  • Modular firmware architecture

Custom STM32 Embedded
Hardware Board

Designed a 2-layer mixed-signal embedded hardware board based on the STM32F407 microcontroller integrating multiple peripherals including motor drivers, Ethernet communication, precision ADC, and audio interfaces.

Components

  • STM32F407
  • STM32F103 Debug
  • CH340 USB-TTL
  • DRV8701
  • ADS122C04 24-bit ADC
  • Ethernet PHY
  • CS43L22 DAC
  • Stereo Mic

Hardware Highlights

  • 2-layer PCB with mixed-signal routing
  • Power distribution & decoupling placement
  • Ground plane for noise isolation
  • Integrated analog, digital & comm subsystems

Key Features

  • High-performance ARM Cortex-M4 platform
  • Precision sensor interfacing — 24-bit ADC
  • Ethernet-based communication
  • Full audio input/output subsystem

PROJECT_03PCB DesignSTM32F411

STM32F411 Breakout
Development Board

Designed a compact STM32F411 microcontroller breakout board to support rapid prototyping and development of embedded systems. Special attention was given to power regulation, decoupling, and PCB layout to ensure reliable microcontroller operation.

Technologies

  • STM32F411
  • UART Interface
  • Embedded C
  • 2-Layer PCB
  • 3.3V LDO

Key Features

  • Accessible STM32F411 GPIO interface headers
  • Stable 3.3V regulated power supply
  • UART-based firmware debugging
  • Suited for embedded & robotics prototyping

Design Focus

  • Compact 2-layer layout for rapid iteration
  • Decoupling caps at each MCU VDD pin
  • Clean power plane for stable operation
  • Breadboard-compatible form factor
